html-css.architecture: semantic, progressive enhancement, BEM/clear naming where appropriate

tailwind.architecture: utility-first with tokenized theme and extracted components when reuse/boundary justifies it
tailwind.notes: Tailwind v4 supports core container queries and mobile-first responsive variants.

typescript.architecture: typed public contracts and narrow domain types

react.architecture: composition, explicit state ownership, effect minimization

nextjs.architecture: App Router/server-client boundary when compatible with project
nextjs.notes: Current Next.js docs distinguish App Router and Pages Router; App Router supports Server Components.
